design.task: identify flipped rows inside the poisoned target class of the training split
design.neural_cleanse: model-level anomaly index; cannot produce per-sample scores, so it is not on the matched-FPR axis
design.clean_models: scored against a random pseudo-poison mask over the same cell, so every detection there is a false positive

headline_sentence: With all four per-sample detectors read off at a common 5% false-positive rate on the same training rows, SPECTRE reached TPR 0.069 (SD 0.029) against 0.002 for Spectral Signatures, 0.001 for Activation Clustering and 0.002 for STRIP, with Neural Cleanse flagging 0/6 attacked models against 0/6 clean models.
